title.narrative: Acceso a la justicia climática, económica, y derechos para mujeres

description.narrative: The aim of the project is to empower resilient women who live in a healthy environment and bring about change in society and their surroundings. To achieve this, it is necessary to take actions within the framework of rural development, gender equality, valuing the role of women farmers and promoting resilient agriculture. It is also important to participate in public spaces, form effective alliances and agroecology, strengthening knowledge, making their voices heard in public spaces, and bring about change in private spaces. This is achieved through effective training, analysis, planning, evaluation, implementation of resilient activities, and advocacy with duty bearers. Information will be systematised and partnerships will be created that are expected to be long-lasting in order to strengthen the women members and the organisation itself.
